data.name: SLC7A5 (LAT1)
data.description: Large neutral amino acid transporter 1, which imports leucine and is a key upstream input into mTORC1 nutrient sensing.
data.description_beginner: A doorway in the cell membrane that carries large amino acids, leucine among them, into the cell. Since mTORC1 measures leucine to judge whether there is enough raw material to grow, this transporter is one of the taps feeding that decision.
